cover_letter_text:
Hi Nassima team,

I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'm looking to start out as a civil draftsperson. Your JobsNext ad asks for that qualification, so I'm putting my hand up.

In the diploma I designed roads, earthworks and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. One drawing on my portfolio is a typical cross-section of a two-lane road with kerbs and drainage. Earlier, on a community hall renovation in the Philippines, I reviewed the structural and architectural drawings and checked the work against them.

I can start two weeks after an offer, and I have a full Victorian driver's licence and my own transport. I've got full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Thanks for reading, and I'm happy to chat.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
